policy: The Family-E animator must stage the complete physical sibling sets for logical D1 package families 00EC and 023D before opening 00EC_5 or 023D_5. EntryReader follows block patch_id ownership into sibling files, so a correct _5 file alone is not a sufficient readable logical package even when its own SHA-256 is exact. These rows pin physical bytes only; animation ownership remains established separately by the closed Family-E ownership report.

negative_evidence.failure: A byte-exact minimal staging containing only 00EC_5 and 023D_5 failed before any GLB mutation because EntryReader.available(809D8613) was false. d1_entry_extract.EntryReader.available() explicitly follows each block's patch_id through patch_path(), proving the missing sibling files are execution dependencies rather than optional discovery context.
negative_evidence.consequence: Do not optimize D1 package-family reads down to the physical member containing the entry table. Stage every sibling required by block patch ownership, and for durable workflows prefer the complete current logical family with exact membership/SHA checks.
